description_en: Queries Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances in a cluster
name: ListClusterMembers

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cluster. You can call the ListCluster operation to query the cluster ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154995.html
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID。可以调用ListCluster来获取，具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154995.html
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. If you do not specify this parameter, the first page is returned
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，当前显示的页面数，不设置的情况下默认显示第1页
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of ECS instances to return on each page. If you do not specify this parameter, all ECS instances in the specified cluster are returned on one page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，若不设置，则显示该集群的所有ECS列表；若设置，则按照设置的pagesize来分页显示ECS列表
parameters.name: page_size

ClusterMemberPage.description_en: The information about the ECS instances in the cluster
ClusterMemberPage.description_zh: 集群中包含的ECS实例页面

ClusterMember.description_en: The list of ECS instances in the cluster
ClusterMember.description_zh: 集群中包含的实例列表

items.description_en: The information about ECS instances in the cluster

ClusterMemberId.description_en: The ID of the ECS instance in the cluster

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the ECS instance was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC

EcsId.description_en: The ID of the ECS instance

EcuId.description_en: The unique ID of the elastic compute unit (ECU). You can run the `dmidecode` command on the ECS instance to query the ECU ID
EcuId.description_zh: 这台ECU的唯一标示ID，可以通过在ECS上执行`dmidecode`获取

PrivateIp.description_en: The private IP address for the ECS instance

Status.description_en:
The state of the ECS instance. Valid values:

1: The instance is running.

0: The instance is being converted.

-1: The instance fails to be converted.

-2: The instance is offline
Status.description_zh:
实例状态：

1：表示运行中。
0：表示转化中。
-1：表示转化失败。
-2：表示离线

UpdateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the ECS instance was updated. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned page. If this parameter is not returned, the first page is returned
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前显示的页面数，不设置的情况下默认显示第1页

PageSize.description_en: The number of ECS instances returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 所有实例分页显示的页面数

TotalSize.description_en: The total number of pages returned when all ECS instances are returned based on the specified PageSize parameter
TotalSize.description_zh: 所有的ECS实例按照PageSize的大小进行分页显示时，总的显示页数

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned
